prompts.label: 向右移动
prompts.prompt:
Create ONE single-character full-body portrait KEY-POSE STUDY for GPT酱 formal iteration.
The input image is a REFERENCE SHEET containing two views of ONE character. Use the LEFT character as identity/costume reference. DO NOT COPY THE SHEET LAYOUT. Output EXACTLY ONE figure. No second figure, no close-up inset, no alternative pose, no comparison panel.
New composition: a vertical portrait canvas, FULL FIGURE centered and occupying at most 75 percent of canvas height and 75 percent of width, generous pure WHITE empty border on ALL FOUR SIDES. Entire horns, hair, fingers, both shoes, both wing tips, dress train and tail tip fully visible with at least 10 percent empty space to every canvas edge. Pure solid opaque white background, no transparency, no aura, no grey/lavender gradient, no shadow, no scenery, no labels.
Faithfully match the user's approved reference: same youthful adult face, alert lavender eyes, silver-white wavy long hair, upward curved white dragon horns, pointed ears, graceful approximately 4.5-head stylized proportions, white dragon wings with clear lavender membranes, long scaled white/lavender dragon tail with pointed tip; same white/lavender fitted high-collar draped dress, open shoulders, detached ruffled sleeves, asymmetric slit and long train, cool silver chain/tassels, knot/rosette ornaments in consistent locations on hair/waist/hem, matching shoes. Crisp polished anime linework and restrained soft shading. Cool palette. Preserve enough silhouette clarity for later 192x208 sprite work. NO new outfit, NO added props, NO text.
Maintain composed, capable, self-possessed, lightly playful temperament; no sleepy gaze, no excessive blush, no begging. This new image is a single state study, not a production sprite, not an edit target or a reference-sheet recreation.
Required state: 向右移动.
Pose: Facing SCREEN RIGHT in a three-quarter right-facing brisk walking stride. Her head follows the direction of movement, calm focused open eyes and closed relaxed mouth. One foot leads forward and the other pushes off, modest natural arm swing. Keep the dress train, sleeves and tail trailing behind to SCREEN LEFT, wings slightly drawn in to move comfortably, retain their structure and long flowing dress. Balanced readable silhouette, head size exactly consistent with the approved character. This is a directional movement state, not the working/thinking state.
